title: Require canonical release state consistency in full quality
outOfScope: Changing release.json, next-release.json, the v0.5.45 candidate, release.yml, installer behavior, tags, GitHub Releases, or provider state.
Weakening the canonical release-state checker, its metadata-digest checks, or any existing quality/release gate.
Publishing, deleting, moving, or retargeting an immutable version tag or public release asset.

sources.reason: Current full quality graph omits check-release-state-consistency while quality-release contains it.
Canonical checker that already detects stale published/candidate metadata digests.
The d7360d9d supply-chain refresh changed this published projection without refreshing the canonical state digest.
Canonical projection currently declares stale metadataDigests.published and must be aligned to release.json bytes.
Regression coverage for the bounded full-quality gate graph.
Deterministic unit coverage for canonical release projection drift.
Byte-bound evidence inventory for the Makefile and release-state regression must be regenerated after their change without changing capability status or claims.
Generated alignment evidence binds the changed Makefile and Capability Truth matrix and must be refreshed rather than left stale.
The final Japanese reassessment byte-binds the changed Makefile and Capability Truth matrix, so its generated evidence must be refreshed before documentation alignment can be recomputed.
User requires discovered process defects to be corrected before the paused release can continue.

riskAssessment.reason: A stale canonical release metadata digest can evade ordinary quality and reach release preparation; this corrective must fail closed without broadening publication authority.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized correcting discovered workflow defects before resuming release, while retaining fail-closed checks and the later full PR lifecycle.

preReviewWarnings: This Work Item must add a quality-path regression, not merely repair the current stale digest.
The release state repair must change only metadataDigests.published to the SHA-256 of current release.json bytes.
The paused v0.5.45 release branch remains out of this Work Item and may resume only after this corrective is merged and closed.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The current release-state.json metadataDigests.published exactly equals the SHA-256 of the current release.json bytes, while every other release identity field remains unchanged.
make quality includes a named, timed check-release-state-consistency gate in its normal full-quality graph; it is not limited to quality-release.
A regression test proves the full-quality graph contains the gate and a repository-level test fails when a real canonical metadata digest drifts.
The Capability Truth matrix is regenerated from the changed source/test evidence without changing capability status, claim scope, or limitations.
The generated pre-release documentation alignment evidence is refreshed and remains semantically aligned after the bounded quality-gate change.

The final Japanese reassessment is regenerated from the same current source bytes and retains zero blocking findings; this does not claim new Japanese capability beyond the existing assessment boundary.
Focused tests and checks prove the corrected state passes, a mutated digest fails, and the added gate remains in the quality graph without introducing parallel write conflicts.
The corrective completes ai-finish, direct active report, archive, one PR, hosted verification, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch deletion, and synchronized main before the paused release is resumed.
guidelines: Repair the process as well as the current state: no metadata-only fix without an executable quality-path regression.
Keep release identity and external publication entirely out of scope.
Use the canonical checker as the release-state authority; do not duplicate its validation logic in Makefile.
Preserve the paused release Contract and immutable archived evidence unchanged.

intent.problem: d7360d9d updated release.json supply-chain evidence without updating release-state.json.metadataDigests.published. The canonical checker detects the resulting drift, but normal make quality omitted that checker, so the inconsistent state could pass ordinary quality and block only late in release preparation.
constraints: Do not alter release identity, candidate v0.5.45, provider workflow, installer, tags, assets, or GitHub Release state.
Add the existing canonical checker to the normal full-quality graph as a separate timed gate.
Prove both actual-repository state alignment and a negative metadata-drift case.
Do not resume or modify the paused release Work Item in this corrective.
intent.rationale: Running the canonical state checker in ordinary full quality prevents release projection drift from surviving unrelated supply-chain refreshes and moves the failure to the earliest shared verification boundary.

verification.reason: User's temporary efficiency authorization permits focused local verification for corrective Work Items; the focused quality-graph and release-state checks remain required, and hosted PR checks still provide independent full-quality evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A release.json byte change leaves release-state metadataDigests.published stale.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The canonical checker fails with a metadata digest error.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use the repository-level checker regression with a deliberately altered published projection/digest relationship.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The current canonical projection is aligned after the narrow repair.
scenarioCoverage.expected: check-release-state-consistency passes and only metadataDigests.published changes in release-state.json.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compute the SHA-256 of current release.json, update only the declared digest, then run the checker and exact diff inspection.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Normal full quality executes canonical release-state consistency.
scenarioCoverage.expected: quality-evidence-group includes a named qg-check-release-state-consistency wrapper alongside the existing release-evidence gate.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Assert the Makefile graph in a focused architecture test and inspect make -n quality output.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The corrective does not change release identity or external publication state.
scenarioCoverage.expected: release.json, next-release.json, workflows, tags, and provider Releases remain untouched.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the final diff, git tag/ref inventory, and GitHub Release state before finish.

rawUserRequest: Before release, fix any discovered process problem rather than repeatedly attempting the release. Continue the authorized plan without unnecessary stops; each Work Item still needs Contract, verification, direct report, archive, PR, hosted CI, merge, closure, and branch cleanup.

declaredIntent.summary: Make canonical release-state projection integrity a normal full-quality gate, repair the observed digest drift, and keep release publication paused until the independent corrective closes.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized fixing discovered process defects before release and continuing through the full governed corrective lifecycle, without weakening any release or quality gate.

rollbackNote: Revert the Makefile gate and regression tests together if they cause an unrelated verified regression; never revert to a stale canonical state digest or alter release identity as a rollback shortcut.
